name: gametracker-vault
description: Personal game log — NestJS backend, React frontend, shared package.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @gametracker/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @gametracker/backend" "npm run dev -w @gametracker/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @gametracker/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @gametracker/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @gametracker/backend && npm run build -w @gametracker/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @gametracker/backend && npm run lint -w @gametracker/frontend
